brief:
Tucker Carlson has alleged that Israel pressured him to report false accusations against Hunter Biden, the son of former US president Joe Biden, Middle East Eye reported. Carlson suggested a "Netanyahu operation centre" played a role in disseminating alleged drug and sex leaks related to Biden's son.

The former television host's claim connects Israeli government involvement to the spread of material targeting the Biden family member. Carlson did not provide supporting documentation for the allegation. The statement adds to ongoing controversy surrounding the origins and authenticity of materials related to Hunter Biden, which have circulated widely in recent years amid disputes over their veracity and provenance.

title: Carlson claims Israel orchestrated false Hunter Biden allegations
